description: This file defines the PayGradeCurrencyAPI class, which provides RESTful CRUD endpoints for managing pay grade currencies within an HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting pay grade currency records, with strong emphasis on validation and integration with other system components. The class also includes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PayGradeCurrencyAPI
classes.description: A RESTful API class providing CRUD operations for managing pay grade currencies, including retrieval, listing, creation, update, and deletion functionalities within the HR management system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Pay Grade Currency by payGradeId and currencyId, returning its data encapsulated in a model suitable for API response.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all pay grade currencies associated with a specific pay grade, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Pay Grade Currency record based on provided request data, associating it with a specified pay grade.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Pay Grade Currency record identified by payGradeId and currencyId with new salary information.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple Pay Grade Currency records specified by their IDs, associated with a particular pay grade.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getOne' API operation to ensure required parameters are present and correctly typed.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing all pay grade currencies, including sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a pay grade currency, ensuring required fields like currencyId, minSalary, and maxSalary are provided.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a pay grade currency, ensuring necessary identifiers and salary fields are valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting pay grade currencies, primarily validating payGradeId and list of IDs.

methods.name: savePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Internal method to handle the creation or update of a PayGradeCurrency entity based on request data, validating related entities and salary constraints.
